name: Chicken & Jalapeño Enchiladas with Creamy White Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Place chicken in a medium saucepan; cover with water and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and let simmer until chicken is cooked through, 8-12 minutes. Remove chicken from the saucepan and place on a plate; discard cooking liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
12 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 jalapeño peppers
3 tomatoes
1 ½ small bunches green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Quarter the jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs of the jalapeños with a spoon. Finely dice and set aside. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing).
Peel and small dice onions. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Heat another medium saucepan over medium heat.
Once the saucepan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the jalapeños, onion, garlic, chili powder, and salt to the saucepan. Cook, stirring occasionally, until vegetables have softened, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp chili powder
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Transfer cooked vegetables from the saucepan to a large bowl. Shred the chicken and add to the bowl with the vegetables. Stir to combine and set aside.
Return medium saucepan to stove over medium heat. Melt the butter, then add the flour. Whisk for 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup butter, unsalted
¼ cup all-purpose flour

instructions.primary_message: Add the broth and salt to the saucepan; whisk until thickened, 2-3 minutes. Remove from the heat and let cool, 3-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Grease the bottom of a baking dish with oil. Place ⅓ cup of chicken filling in the center of each tortilla. Top chicken with 1 tbsp of cheese. Roll tightly and place seam-side down in the baking dish.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil
12 small flour tortillas

instructions.primary_message: Add yogurt to the pan with the sauce and whisk until smooth. Pour the sauce over the tortillas in the baking dish. Top with the remaining cheese. Place baking dish in the oven and broil until cheese is melted and bubbly, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, small dice the tomato and green onion.
Divide the enchiladas between plates and top with tomato and green onion. Enjoy!
